description: Application to vary the approved drawings listed under Condition 2 and amend the wording of Conditions 24 (Car Parking), 25 (Cycle Parking) and 39 (Development Particulars) attached to planning consent reference 21/02087/VAR dated 21/12/2022 (original consent ref: 18/02013/FUL dated 07/01/2020). For information only: For the purposes of public consultation, the following additional information describing the proposal is provided (this does not form part of the formal description of development set out above): Alterations including additional height to Blocks A2 (2 storeys added), A3 (4 storeys added), C1 (1 storey added) and C3 (1 storey added) to accommodate 51 no. 1, 2 and 3 bedroom residential flats. Removal of ground floor car park below Blocks A2, A3 & C1, relocation of blue badge bays, and lowering of podium to first floor level to form a further 5 no. 1, 2 and 3 bedroom flats. Internal alterations to Blocks A2, A3, C1 and C3, to facilitate additional staircases to all levels.
